messages.subject: Gallery demo works in Chrome not in Safari
parts:
Hello,

Are Shiny features browser dependent? For example a gallery demo is working in Chrome but not in Safari.

Gallery/Shiny Server Pro/Authentication and database:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/authentication-and-database.html
- works in Chrome
- does not work in Safari

In Safari*:
1. Enter username ..
2. Enter password ..
3. Press Log in
-> Log in dialog re/appears with empty fields.

*) Safari 10.0.3

Jiri
